project_name: MART Token Ecosystem - Agent Compute, Manual Execution & Budget Estimator

summary_of_changes.compute_credits: Operational compute credit system per token with detailed usage breakdown, cost limits, auto-refill threshold, and internal test credits (no external monetary payment required).
summary_of_changes.manual_research_run: Mandatory creator manual research execution run ('Jalankan Agent') using chosen model before automated/scheduled agent workflows can be activated.
summary_of_changes.budget_estimator: Pre-top-up Budget & Cost Estimator calculating operational compute costs based on creator's chosen AI model (DeepSeek R1, Sonnet 3.5, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3) and job frequency (Hourly, Daily, Event-Triggered).
summary_of_changes.activity_log_events: Live activity event log stream for every token in the Token Hub displaying agent step executions (Observe -> Research -> Strategy -> Action), model prompts, compute consumption, and timestamped logs.
summary_of_changes.treasury_removal: Completely removed Treasury UI components, tabs, and breakdown panels from Token Hub and creator workflows. Historical treasury data remains archived on the backend without active UI exposure.

theme_strategy.surface_treatment: Tactical dark obsidian cards with 1px hairline borders (#232b2d or #294934) and subtle backdrop filters. Pure transparent headers/cards are forbidden.

token_hub_breakdown_layout.structure: Integrated Split View on Token Hub Overview
left_main_column: DexScreener/Native Live Price Chart with timeframes (1H, 24H, 7D)
Token Stat Grid: Price, Market Cap, 24h Volume, Liquidity, Holder Count
Activity Log & Agent Execution Stream (Observe, Research, Strategy, Action events)
right_agent_column: Agent Core Identity & Status Badge (Active / Standby / Unconfigured)
Creator-Selected AI Model Badge (DeepSeek R1, Sonnet 3.5, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3)
Compute Credit Balance Card (Current Credits, Daily Burn Rate, Cost Limit)
Manual Execution Trigger ('Jalankan Agent' button for instant research run)
Scheduled Work Toggle (Unlocked ONLY after successful manual run)
Budget Estimator Card (Model, Frequency, Estimated Monthly Compute Cost)

compute_credit_system.cost_limit_controls: Creator sets maximum daily cost ceiling (e.g. Max 50 COMPUTECR/day)
compute_credit_system.top_up: Internal test credit claims (100 free test credits per request, no payment required)

parameters: Selected AI Model (DeepSeek R1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3 70B)
Run Frequency (Realtime/Event, Hourly, Every 6 Hours, Daily)
budget_estimator_system.output_calculation: Displays projected daily, weekly, and monthly credit expenditure with cost breakdown before topping up.

agent_manual_execution_and_scheduler_gat.manual_button: Action button 'Jalankan Agent' triggers immediate manual research run with live progress step feedback.
agent_manual_execution_and_scheduler_gat.scheduled_toggle: Schedule toggle is locked disabled with tooltip 'Jalankan 1x riset manual terlebih dahulu' until at least 1 manual run completes successfully.

treasury_removal_policy.hub_overview: Removed all Treasury allocation charts, balance splits, and treasury metrics.
treasury_removal_policy.navigation: Removed any references to Treasury across all pages.
treasury_removal_policy.backend: Data structures preserved silently; UI elements completely replaced by Compute Credits and Activity Logs.

component_instructions.data_test_ids: Mandatory kebab-case data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and status cards.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Preserve original MART visual identity (Deep Obsidian #080B0D, Emerald #00EFA0, JetBrains Mono, Outfit fonts).
Enforce mandatory manual run ('Jalankan Agent') before enabling scheduled agent automation.
Provide clear compute credit balance, usage breakdown, cost limit, and budget estimator.
Provide real-time / interactive activity logs with events for all token hubs.
Completely remove Treasury panels/UI elements across the app.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
